seo_description: Mara River Camp on a bend of the Mara River in the Maasai Mara, and Watamu Beach Club & Villas on Mayungu Bay. What you will live, what to expect and how to book direct.
title: Wherever there is something unique to explore
lead: A tented camp in the Maasai Mara and villas on the Kenyan coast. Each place is true to its setting, and every one offers all five ways to explore.
next_body: A tented camp today. A reef, a vineyard or a town house tomorrow. Every new place answers the same seven questions before it carries the name.
alt: The Mara River curving between grassland and trees, seen from above
